acceptance_criteria.description: Referenced source owners remain catalog and validation anchors but emit no ledger observation.
Distinct aggregate records remain observations and reconciliation targets.
Only digest-equivalent dataset identity enrichment is accepted; conflicting known identity fails.
Imports without unit results retain byte-identical projections.
Focused tests, import/collaboration validation, lint, type, and diff checks pass.

objective: Prevent duplicate owner and unit observations while allowing fail-closed dataset identity enrichment for aggregate reconciliation.
title: Make historical unit owners reference-only in ledger projection
